messages:
Anna: Quick post-incident sync — near-OOM in apac-east during yesterday's promo window. Putting a short summary here and requests for owners. TL;DR: autoscaler reacted too late, KV cache eviction and AZ egress throttles amplified GPU hotspots, and we narrowly avoided hard OOM by falling back to the smaller model for ~7% of requests. Need immediate fixes + a 72h guardband for upcoming promos.

Jordan: Short facts from metrics/logs: GPUs hit ~93% util at peak, we saw repeated OOM warnings around 2026-06-12T20:19Z, average token latency doubled at peak, and drop/throttle callbacks increased.

Jordan: Logs/snippet: 
```
peak_gpu_util: 93.1%
estimated_oom_warnings: 20:19:42 UTC
avg_token_latency_ms: 210 -> 480
drop_rate_pct: 0.8
requests_fallbacked_to-small-model_pct: 7.1
```

Leo: Root cause summary: forecast underestimated the promo uplift in apac-east by ~2.2x (we used baseline + weekday multipliers only). Autoscaler had scale_down_delay=300s and headroom=10% which meant we didn't bring capacity up fast enough. On top of that we hit AZ egress soft limits (~1.2Gbps per-AZ) which caused request redistribution and localized GPU hot spots in a single AZ. The combination produced sustained high memory pressure and a cascade of KV cache evictions.

Maya: From product side: we launched the promo flag without a capacity reservation request. Forecast input used 'last_year_baseline' only; we missed coupon stacking and influencer traffic spike. We need a "promo" dimension in the forecasting pipeline so we can auto-enrich predictions when marketing schedules promotions.

Priya: Remediation/actionables proposal (ops):
1) Immediate: increase apac-east min pool by +30 GPUs for next 72 hours to cushion tail-risk.
2) Autoscaler tweaks: reduce scale_down_delay -> 120s, increase default headroom -> 20% for promo-tagged routes.
3) Prewarm job: spin warm-up replicas 10m before promo start when promo flag is set.
4) Cloud: request temporary AZ egress uplift with provider for promo windows (file support ticket).
5) Cache: increase KV cache soft quota + pin hot keys for 24-48h.
6) Cost tagging: ensure all promo-related capacity is tagged to marketing campaign for chargeback.

Jordan: Also recommend KV cache TTLs be extended for recurring sessions and add hot-key pinning to prevent churn. We should also add a short-circuit route so very high concurrency customers get throttled earlier (graceful degrade) instead of causing cluster-wide pressure.

Anna: Owners:
- Increase min pool / temporary reservation -> Leo (infra)
- Autoscaler config -> Jordan (sre)
- Forecasting input change -> Maya (product) + Priya (ops) to request vocalized margin
- Runbook/update fallback thresholds -> Anna (ops) + Jordan
- Support ticket to cloud for egress bump -> Priya

Anna: Please reply with ack + ETA for each action. Let's also plan a 15m follow-up at 09:00 PT to confirm progress. :eyes:

Maya: Ack — I'll update forecasting by EOD and add a test harness for promo flags into the pipeline.

Leo: Ack — bumping min pool now (will provide change id), will also add AZ-aware placement to reduce hot-spotting. ETA ~45m for immediate change.

Jordan: Ack — autoscaler change staged in canary, rolling to a subset of apac-east pools. Will monitor for oscillation. ETA ~30m to finish rollout.

Priya: Ack — filing cloud ticket now for egress uplift and will tag the temporary capacity to marketing campaign id. Also will draft incident RCA doc.

incident-bot: Incident report created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/IR-2026-142 — contains full log bundle, timeline, and playbook.

Anna: Thanks all. Postmortem outline: 1) timeline + metrics, 2) root cause (forecast + autoscaler + egress), 3) mitigations implemented, 4) permanent changes (forecasting dims, autoscaler policy, runbook updates), 5) cost analysis. Priya — include cost delta for the 72h bump in RCA.

Jordan: One extra note: add a trigger in our monitoring that alerts when cross-AZ request skew > 18% for more than 60s — that was a key signal we missed.

Maya: Also recommending a pre-promo checklist in the marketing playbook: confirm capacity reservation + paired load test + TTL policy.

Anna: Will follow up with minutes + owners + tickets in this thread. If anyone finds additional causal evidence (e.g., a patched model that increased mem footprint) drop logs here.

Leo: dropping change id: change/infra/2026/4521 for the min pool bump.

Priya: filed cloud support ticket: CS-99823 (requesting AZ egress uplift for 3 days, linked to IR-2026-142).

Jordan: rolling postmortem doc to /docs/incidents/IR-2026-142 — will link once published.

Anna: Closing note: good catch on fallback working as intended — saved us from a full outage. Let's make the temporary changes standard for the next 48h and then circle back on cost vs. risk. :thumbsup:
